title: Find Resultant Array After Removing Anagrams
summary: Given a 0-indexed string array words consisting of lowercase English letters, repeatedly remove any word at index i (where 0 < i < words.length) if it is an anagram of the word immediately preceding it (words[i - 1]).
statement: Given a 0-indexed string array words consisting of lowercase English letters, repeatedly remove any word at index i (where 0 < i < words.length) if it is an anagram of the word immediately preceding it (words[i - 1]). Continue performing this operation as long as such pairs exist. Return the array after all such operations have been performed. It is guaranteed that the order in which you remove the anagram pairs does not affect the final result. An anagram is defined as a word formed by rearranging the letters of another word using all the letters exactly once.
constraints: Repeatedly delete a word when it is an anagram of the current preceding retained word.
Preserve the original spelling and order of retained words.
Two words are anagrams when their sorted character multisets match.
hints: Canonicalize a word by sorting its characters.
Only compare with the signature of the last retained group, because all consecutive equal signatures collapse to their first word.
Append the word and update previous signature only when its signature differs.
Induction over the input maintains exactly the result after fully deleting anagram pairs in the processed prefix.
editorial: Induction over the input maintains exactly the result after fully deleting anagram pairs in the processed prefix.

tests.explanation: The first three words share one signature and the last two another, leaving abba and cd.
No adjacent words are anagrams, so all remain.
